subject: re-stage done; run_host_tests blocked at native strict link (stale Rust iOS archive)
body:
RE-STAGE DONE, but run_host_tests.sh does NOT yet reach "all offline GPU tests passed": the last step fails for a reason outside the kernel sources.
Done (nice -n 10, under the approval): backup gpu/build/xnu-stage-backup-pre-p15-20261028/ (xnu-stage, xnu-obj, fakeroot, sdk-kernel-platform, old 0084); stage_xnu.sh (overlay = repo P15 sources); regenerate_patch.sh -> xnu/patches/0084-nord2-gpu.patch rewritten (tracked, will show as modified: 40 files, sha256 2377ba5f50dd702a; old copy in the backup). Not touched: gpu/metal/**, xnu-side files outside the repo (Sweet*, cpufreq) which stay in the K patches 0085..0113.
run_host_tests.sh now: ARM64 XNU compile of all nord2_gpu_*.c + Nord2GPU.cpp OK (archive build/libnord2gpu.a), 0084 reverse-apply check OK, size delta OK (synthetic baseline 17849472 -> +GPU 17974576, delta 125104 B), addon install/update/journal tests PASS, everything earlier PASS (Metal/JM bridge suite, API surface, IOSurface, tessellator).
FAILS at "actual iOS bundle strict link" (tools/link_metal_bundle.py): ld64.lld undefined symbol tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_buffer_templates, referenced from the freshly built build/tegu-frontend/libNord2MetalFrontend.a (compute_frontend.o, tegu_render_plan_generic_cached). The symbol exists in gpu/metal/tegu/air_bridge.rs:2707 and air_bridge.h:570 (edited 14:19) but NOT in research/nord2-native-air/target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libtegu_air_bridge.a (built 13:49; llvm-nm shows plan_generic and plan_generic_specialized only). I.e. the iOS Rust archive is stale against the current frontend source (the "no runtime ABI handshake" risk from the audit, caught here by the strict link). Fix = rebuild the Rust iOS archive (`build_native_compilers.py air`, heavy cargo, jobs1, native lease) then rerun the last two steps (link_metal_bundle.py, tools/build_metal_probe.sh) or the whole script. libNord2Mali.a (13:50) may also need a rebuild if the frontend references newer Mali symbols; the link will say. I did NOT start that cargo build: it is owned by the native/compute workers (a9f7 is currently building a private air_bridge) and shares cargo-target and build/native outputs. Parent: please assign/lease it; I can rerun run_host_tests.sh immediately afterwards and post the final "all offline GPU tests passed".
Kernel-side stable point is unchanged (post "STABLE POINT: kernel sources P14 (+0113)"): the repo files are P15 and the commit "kernel sources P15" may include xnu/patches/0084-nord2-gpu.patch.
